desc: Sun angel: long white robe, a gold sunburst plate behind its back, three stacked layers of white and gold wings on each side, gold scepter. Face: sleepy half-lidded white eyes. Chibi 16-bit pixel art character sprite, big head, small body, right-facing 3/4, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no halo, no shadow. Face is a solid black void with the described eyes. Palette lavender, white, violet, gold.
